confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates draw on [May 2026 prices](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/slovakia/bratislava/restaurants/) and a [2026 drinks guide](https://www.bratislava-escape.com/guides/budget-guide/), with some extrapolation to July. Cocktail and wine estimates are roughly three and 1.5 times the beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; summer weekends and events can cause substantial variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Central European capitals, adjusted for Bratislava's smaller scale, proximity to Vienna, and July tourism demand.
